claims.text: The proposed PCC-WFE feature expansion technique improves the performance of traditional classifiers on the UCI Epileptic Seizure Recognition dataset (Dataset 2 with the added feature vs Dataset 1 without it).
The SGRU classifier (stacked GRU with residual additions and mish activation) achieves high accuracy on the epilepsy diagnosis task on both Dataset 1 and Dataset 2.
XGBoost is the best of the four traditional classifiers on the PCC-WFE expanded data (accuracy 0.9513, recall 0.8913, precision 0.9541).
The PCC-WFE new feature is a weighted sum of the features positively correlated with the label, with weights proportional to the Pearson correlation coefficient.
The dataset has 11,500 samples, 178 features and 5 classes of 2,300 samples each.
The SGRU/GRU comparison is evaluated by 10-fold cross-validation on both Dataset 1 (178 features) and Dataset 2 (179 features).
